Geographies Served Programs Awareness and enrollment of volunteer blood stem cell donors District Chennai State Tamil Nadu Uttar Pradesh Chandigarh Delhi Goa Gujarat Haryana Kerala Maharashtra Punjab Rajasthan Andhra Pradesh Karnataka Telangana West Bengal District Chennai States Tamil Nadu Uttar Pradesh Chandigarh Delhi Goa Gujarat Haryana Kerala Maharashtra Punjab Rajasthan Andhra Pradesh Karnataka Telangana West Bengal In its Drives programme, the organization encourages individuals to support those affected by life-threatening blood disorders such as Blood Cancer, Thalassemia, and Sickle Cell Anaemia. By collaborating with DATRI, individuals have the opportunity to organise donor drives, playing a crucial role in facilitating the search for compatible donors and ultimately helping patients in need. Stem Cell Donor Awareness and Enrollment Programme State Tamil Nadu Uttar Pradesh Chandigarh Delhi Goa Gujarat Haryana Kerala Maharashtra Punjab Rajasthan Andhra Pradesh Karnataka Telangana West Bengal States Tamil Nadu Uttar Pradesh Chandigarh Delhi Goa Gujarat Haryana Kerala Maharashtra Punjab Rajasthan Andhra Pradesh Karnataka Telangana West Bengal Considering the profound impact of blood disorders like cancer and Thalassemia, becoming a Blood Stem Cell Donor is a crucial step in providing hope and a potential cure. With a mere 25% chance of finding a familial donor, patients often rely on Unrelated Blood Stem Cell Donors, where the odds of a match range from 1 in 10,000 to 1 in over a Million. The organisation emphasizes the significance of this act, as an Unrelated Blood Stem Cell Transplant is frequently the sole cure for such life-threatening disorders. To contribute to this life-saving cause, individuals are encouraged to take the initiative by registering as potential Bone Marrow or Peripheral Blood Stem Cell Donors.
